Jordan (People Ops): Heads up — launching a 6-month pilot for PTO -> Flex Credit conversion starting 2026-05-12. You can convert up to 5 unused PTO days into Flex Credits (usable for caregiving, mental-health support, or qualifying travel reimbursements). Also rolling out a short emergency-evac briefing requirement for company-funded international travel. Details + opt-in form: https://go.redwood/pto-convert :sparkles:
Maya L.: Nice, thank you! Is this retroactive to days accrued earlier this year?
Jordan (People Ops): Not retroactive — only days accrued during the pilot window are eligible. We'll explain accrual math in the policy doc.
Tomas R.: Quick Q — how do Flex Credits show up? Payroll adjustment or reimbursement pool?
Jordan (People Ops): They appear as a "Flex Wallet" in Compass (People Ops portal). Use expense code `FLEX` when submitting reimbursements; finance will process from the wallet balance. Demo coming.
Priya S.: For the emergency-evac briefing — synchronous or async? I travel a lot and timezones matter.
Jordan (People Ops): We'll do a 20–30 min live session + a recorded version. Completion requires a 2-question quiz (very short). Required for company-funded trips >72 hours or any travel to regions on the high-risk list. Certificate auto-attaches to travel requests.
Rafael G.: :thumbsup: Where's the high-risk list maintained?
Jordan (People Ops): Travel KB: https://kb.redwood/travel/high-risk. It's updated weekly based on gov advisories + our vendor input.
PeopleOps-Bot: Reminder: PTO->Flex opt-in form closes 2026-06-01. Link: https://go.redwood/pto-convert (an auto-reminder will DM people who started but didn't submit).
Maya L.: Can managers opt people in on their behalf?
Jordan (People Ops): Managers can pre-approve conversions for direct reports only with written consent from the employee — we'll add a manager flow in the form.
Priya S.: Useful — will there be a list of covered uses for FLEX reimbursements? e.g., childcare, coworking, therapy?
Jordan (People Ops): Yes — initial eligible categories: childcare, short-term mental-health support, last-mile travel to/from caregiving, and short-term coworking to support remote work. We'll publish full FAQ.
Tomas R.: Does this affect holiday carryover caps?
Jordan (People Ops): No change to existing carryover policy. This is an additional option, not a replacement.
Priya S.: Thanks — tagging hiring folks to note for new hires who might join during pilot.
Jordan (People Ops): Good call. We'll include a section for new joiners. Recording and FAQ will be posted in #people-ops and via email tomorrow. :email:
Rafael G.: Appreciated.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks everyone — please fill the opt-in if you're interested and ping me with questions. :wave:
